== Description ==

[[Chris Schoenthal]] (seated at the laptop, navy graphic tee, royal-blue cap with a yellow S, glasses, long full beard) and [[Bill Kafer]] (standing right, Yoda / Star Wars Celebration jersey with the TACOBILL mark, black cap, glasses, reddish beard (profile)) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
